title: Normalized open tensor transport through a coefficient equivalence
statement: Let C and D be sites in common category universes, and let the coefficient universe contain the site universes. Suppose the additive sheafifications and locally-bijective criteria on C, D and the slice C/W are available. Let R and S be commutative ring sheaves on C and D, F:C/W→D continuous and cocontinuous, and a:R|W→F_*S an isomorphism. Suppose I is an equivalence of S-module sheaves with R|W-module sheaves, with a specified isomorphism η from its forward functor to the concrete coefficient pushforward. Use the native tensor and pure sections of [lem-sf-open-coefficient-tensor-pushforward]. Put L=I.forward⋙j_! and P=j^*⋙I.inverse, with the literal localized slice operations of [lem-sf-ringed-slice-tensor-generators]. There is a family μ:(LM)⊗N ≅ L(M⊗PN), natural in both maps. Its value on each original extension summand of η.inverse(x), tensored with the counit applied to η.inverse(y), is the original extension summand of η.inverse(x⊗y). This concerns ordinary module sheaves only.

proof.text: Conjugate the generic coefficient pushforward tensorator by η. Use the inverse counit of I to replace the literal slice restriction of N by I.forward(PN). Package the resulting native/site tensor comparison as a natural isomorphism.

On each slice pure section, cancel the counit and inverse counit. The η maps cancel their inverses and the coefficient tensorator fixes pure sections. This proves the local tensorator normalization, before applying extension.

Compose the normalized slice projection formula with extension of this local tensorator. Naturality is composition of the corresponding two-variable natural isomorphisms. On an original summand, the slice generator formula followed by extension_map and the local normalization gives precisely the asserted summand.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedCoefficientTensorTransport :
    let L := I.functor ⋙ localizedSystemExtension.{c, v, r} R W
    let P := localizedSystemRestriction.{c, v, r} R W ⋙ I.inverse
    ∃ μ : ∀ (M : scalarModules K S) (N : scalarModules J R),
        (monoidalCategory R).tensorObj (L.obj M) N ≅
          L.obj ((monoidalCategory S).tensorObj M (P.obj N)),
      (∀ {M M' : scalarModules K S} {N N' : scalarModules J R}
        (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N'),
        (monoidalCategory R).tensorHom (L.map f) g ≫ (μ M' N').hom =
          (μ M N).hom ≫ L.map ((monoidalCategory S).tensorHom f (P.map g))) ∧
      ∀ (M : scalarModules K S) (N : scalarModules J R) (V : C) (b : V ⟶ W)
        (x : M.val.obj (op (F.obj (Over.mk b))))
        (y : (P.obj N).val.obj (op (F.obj (Over.mk b)))),
        (μ M N).hom.val.app (op V)
          (pure R (L.obj M) N (op V)
            (ringedSliceExtensionSection.{c, v, r} R W (I.functor.obj M) (Over.mk b)
              ((η.inv.app M).val.app (op (Over.mk b)) x))
            ((I.counitIso.app (N.over W)).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk b))
              ((η.inv.app (P.obj N)).val.app (op (Over.mk b)) y))) =
          ringedSliceExtensionSection.{c, v, r} R W
            (I.functor.obj ((monoidalCategory S).tensorObj M (P.obj N))) (Over.mk b)
            ((η.inv.app ((monoidalCategory S).tensorObj M (P.obj N))).val.app
              (op (Over.mk b)) (pure S M (P.obj N) (op (F.obj (Over.mk b))) x y))
